why: The relation arises from a written or unwritten contract and exists by the mere fact of working: needed to ground the first element.
Proof of the contract or the relation by any means: needed for the proof note of element e1.
The ways an employment relation ends (resignation, dismissal, end of term): to tell a dismissal from other terminations (boundary n4).
Reduction of staff as collective dismissal for economic reasons: a boundary or exit of this claim.
Duties before a reduction of staff: same boundary.
Method of a reduction of staff: same boundary.
Dismissal indemnity of one month per year of work: a usual accessory request.
Duty to adopt an internal regulation from a staff threshold: the procedure of the dismissal article refers to it.
Content of the internal regulation, disciplinary qualification of faults and procedures: measures the procedure the dismissal article requires.
Termination during the trial period without notice or indemnity.
Protection of staff delegates from dismissal for their mandate.
Work certificate on the end of the relation: accessory request r6.
Continuation of labour relations when the employer's legal situation changes (successor employer).
Fixed-term contract concluded against the rules treated as indefinite: bears on dismissal claims after a term.
